first_visit.text: Come in, come in. I am Auntie Bee. And your good name?
First time here ah? Auntie Bee. What do people call you?
Morning! Auntie Bee, gardener, chief busybody. And what do I call you?
Sit, sit. I am Auntie Bee. How do I call you?
Every plant here has a name. I am Auntie Bee. Yours?

return_visit.text: Eh {name}, you came back. The garden noticed, I noticed also.
Morning {name}. Your plot behaved itself, mostly. Come and see.
There you are {name}. Nothing moved, everything still where you left it.
Wah {name}, good timing. The {plant} pot was asking about you.
Same soil, same auntie, same you. Some things do not change.
Good you came {name}. The {plant} leaves opened up this morning.

return_after_absence.text: Eh {name}, there you are. The garden kept your seat warm.
Look who the morning brought. Come {name}, nothing here changed.
The garden held everything for you {name}. Roots are patient like that.
Ah, good, you are here. The {plant} pot perked up already.
Whenever you come is the right time {name}. Come, look around.
So glad you came. This one still remembers {memory_hint} perfectly.

planting.text: There. Roots first, leaves later. That is how everything starts.
Wah {name}, this one went in like it belongs here.
Press down gentle ah. There, now it can settle in.
Fresh soil, morning light. This one picked a lucky corner.
Aiyo, my hands are all soil again. Worth it though.
Planted. Nothing to do now except let it take its time.

plant_comment.text: That {plant} patch is coming along nicely. Steady, like you.
Look at the {plant} leaves today. Green enough to show off.
This one remembers {memory_hint} better than I do.
Your {plant} corner is my favourite part of this garden.
Every morning I check the {plant} pot first. Old habit.
Wah, this {plant} stem got tall while nobody was looking.

watering.text: Listen to that. The soil drinks it straight down.
Cool soil now. That is the whole reward, honestly.
Good pour {name}. You can smell the wet earth already.
There. Every leaf sitting up straighter than a minute ago.
Water goes in, worry goes out. Works for me lah.
Nice long drink. That one will not ask again today.

wilt_notice.text: This one is having a nap. A drink wakes it right up.
Your {plant} plant is only thirsty. Nothing serious, water fixes it.
Sleepy leaves this morning. Give it water, watch it stand again.
Aiyo, thirsty already. Plants drink more than us in this heat.
Nothing wrong here {name}. Just a thirsty plant and an easy fix.
The soil went dry, the sun is greedy. Water sorts it out.

harvest.text: Basket is filling up. Take what you want, leave the rest.
Wah, enough here for the whole corridor. No need to hurry.
The {plant} basket is heavy today. My arms are complaining.
Fresh from the soil. Nothing at the market beats this.
More than we can finish. That is a nice problem.
Snip, snip, into the basket. It grows back, always does.

meal_unlock.text: Aiyah, now I am hungry. That set makes a proper dish.
New card for your collection. My mother cooked this one.
Can almost smell it, right? New dish card for you.
Your {plant} harvest finished the set. A dish just opened.
This one your family will recognise before you say the name.
Wah {name}, that basket just turned into somebody's favourite dinner.

photo_result.text: Wah, this {plant} photo. You found that outside your own block?
That {plant} picture made my morning. Bring me more, ah.
Out for a walk, back with {plant} seeds. Steady.
Into the garden it goes. Your {plant} row starts today.
Aiyo, this {plant} one is my favourite so far today.
This one used to grow near my old place too.

story_retell.text: I still remember {object_phrase}. Whole afternoons of it {where_phrase}.
You planted an afternoon {where_phrase} and it still sits {feeling_phrase}.
One afternoon {where_phrase}, good company {who_phrase}, and I grew from it.
That day still comes back {feeling_phrase}, every single time.
Every leaf here grew out of that afternoon {where_phrase}.
The talking that day {who_phrase} still lands {feeling_phrase} in me.
